load_vip_model: load the VIP vision model using load_vip() from the vip package
set_model_eval_mode: set the VIP model to evaluation mode with vip.eval()
move_model_to_device: move the VIP model to GPU or CPU with vip.to(device)
create_image_preprocessing_pipeline: create a torchvision preprocessing pipeline with Resize, CenterCrop, and ToTensor transforms
encode_image_to_embedding: encode a preprocessed image through the VIP model to get a [1, 1024] embedding
